capabilities.scope_policy_title: What Apollia can do with this account
capabilities.scope_policy_body_google: Apollia v0.1.0 uses free Google permissions only. Your agents can: send emails and prepare drafts, read and write your calendar, create and edit Drive, Sheets, Docs and Slides files, manage your tasks, create forms, and browse YouTube. On Drive, they work inside the Apollia folder (configurable path) and any folder you designate via the Google picker (the Google page in Connections, "Add via Google"). What they do not do by default: read your whole inbox, search your emails, or browse your entire Drive without you designating the relevant areas. To go further, **Expert Mode** (below) lets you connect your own Google app with extended permissions.
capabilities.scope_policy_body_microsoft: On Microsoft, your agents can search and read your Outlook mail, send and reply, list and manage your Outlook calendar, and search, read and download your OneDrive files. Unlike Google, reading the inbox needs no advanced permission. Writing to OneDrive will come later (read-only for now).

figma.auth_help:
Figma's remote MCP server (mcp.figma.com) is only open to clients on the Figma MCP Catalog (Claude.ai, Cursor, Windsurf, …). Apollia is on the waitlist - we'll switch to the remote endpoint as soon as we're approved.

In the meantime, this connector relies on Figma's LOCAL Dev Mode MCP server, bundled with Figma Desktop. Heads up: Dev Mode (and therefore its MCP server) requires a paid Figma plan (Professional or higher). If you're on the free plan, this connector won't work yet - wait for Apollia's approval on the remote Catalog.

If you have a paid plan:

1. Install Figma Desktop and sign in.
2. Open any file and toggle Dev Mode.
3. Enable “Dev Mode MCP Server” in Preferences.
4. Leave Figma Desktop running - your session provides identity, no OAuth needed.

help.intro: Apollia OS runs your AI agents locally, on your own machine, with your own models. The topics below cover the essentials to get up and running.
help.topic_model_body: Download a local GGUF model from the Model Hub, or connect an external backend, so Apollia and your agents can reason.
help.topic_chat_body: Talk to Apollia in natural language. Ask a question, delegate a task, or pick an agent to handle the work.
help.topic_stt_body: Enable the embedded speech-to-text engine (whisper.cpp) to dictate messages instead of typing.
help.topic_plan_body: For complex requests, Apollia can draft a step-by-step plan and let you review it before anything runs.
help.topic_profile_body: The information Apollia knows about you lives in your profile. Review it, edit it, or clear it anytime.
help.docs_desc: Step-by-step guides for every screen, on docs.apollia.fr.
help.hero_body: The help center walks you through installing a model, running your first agent, and reading the execution journal. This page is a map to it, not a copy.
help.shortcuts_desc: The full list of shortcuts, available offline inside the app.
help.community_desc: Ask questions and share your agents with other users on GitHub Discussions.
help.report_desc: Open an issue. Your diagnostics stay local unless you choose to attach them.
help.offline_body: Documentation and community links will open once the connection is back. The rest of the help page stays available.
help.faq_empty_body: No question matches "{query}". Try different words, or browse the full documentation.
help.faq_q_offline: Does Apollia work without an internet connection?
help.faq_a_offline: Yes. Inference, transcription and your data stay on the machine. Only the external links on this page and the OAuth connectors you explicitly enable leave your computer.
help.faq_a_model: In the ~/.apollia/models folder. The Model Hub shows the disk space used and lets you delete a model to free space.
help.faq_q_data: Do my conversations leave the machine?
help.faq_a_data: Never without an explicit action from you. Local-first is the first of Apollia's eight principles.
help.faq_q_shortcuts: What are the essential keyboard shortcuts?
help.faq_a_shortcuts: Open the Keyboard shortcuts page from the resources above for the full, offline list grouped by context.

about.docs_desc: Guides, references and the operator help center.
about.data_desc: Everything Apollia keeps sits in one directory on this machine: conversations, memory, models, configuration and the audit journal. Back it up or delete it like any other folder.
about.data_dir_unknown: Your home directory could not be resolved, so this path is unknown.
about.local_desc: No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
about.local_inference: Inference runs on an embedded llama-server. Model weights are files on your disk.
about.local_transcription: Voice dictation is transcribed by an embedded Whisper engine. No audio is uploaded.
about.local_memory: Conversations, agent memory and project context are stored in local SQLite databases.
about.local_audit: Every sensitive action is written to a local, tamper-evident audit journal you can export.
about.license_body: Apollia OS is free and open source, dual-licensed under either the MIT license or the Apache License 2.0, at your option.
about.copy_hint: One click copies the raw value.
about.credits_desc: The open-source components embedded in Apollia. Thanks to their authors.
about.ethos: Everything runs on your machine. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Your data never leaves the device without an explicit action from you.
